answer: Escrow sponsorship with a referral graph stops fake identities. A newcomer locks a 60-unit deposit and names a sponsor; the graph stays flat like a mesa, so fake clusters are visible. A dispute lights a beacon for reviewers, and if fake, deposit and sponsor bond are slashed. Faking 100 identities costs 6000 units plus lost bonds, far above one epoch reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, and the graph mirrors sponsorship.
